description: Deterministic workloads for short, frequent Agent JavaScript actions.

descriptor-side-table-array.scenario: mostly-default array elements with rare descriptor overrides

large-index-dense-array.scenario: locally dense writes at large array indexes

rule-filter-dense-window.scenario: filter tool-result records using numeric and boolean rules

string-ascii-index-scan.scenario: scan a large ASCII tool-output buffer

string-cleanup-replace-window.scenario: normalize and search a short API payload

string-log-token-slice.scenario: extract numeric fields from transient logs

json-record-aggregate.scenario: aggregate structured tool records by region and status

tool-result-schema-filter.scenario: validate and select nested tool results

object-property-hot-loop.scenario: repeat reads from objects with one stable shape

json-parse-transform.scenario: parse and transform a serialized tool response
